stemMd: “Every department stayed within its own travel budget. Therefore the company stayed within its total operating budget.” Which flaw is most apparent?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It assumes that departments have identical travel budgets.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It uses the company’s result to infer every department’s result.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It counts the same traveller twice.

options.label: D
options.textMd: It assumes travel is always free.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It generalizes from one category of expenditure to the entire operating budget.

explanationMd: Even complete compliance with travel allocations does not settle spending on salaries, materials, or other operating categories. The conclusion has broader scope than the evidence.

distractorRationale.b: The argument proceeds in the opposite direction.
distractorRationale.c: No counting evidence supports that specific problem.
distractorRationale.a: Equal budgets are not needed for the stated premise.
distractorRationale.d: Travel budgets imply spending is possible.
